QuestInfo.name: Tracing the Resonance
QuestInfo.0: #b#p304##k seemed to recognize the dark magic clinging to me. She may be willing to help after all.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p304##k agreed to help, but the ambient dark energy is too overwhelming to track blindly. She asked me to hunt #r#o37#s#k in #b#m010002081##k and gather #b25 #t4031088#s#k to use as an alchemical tracking focus.
QuestInfo.2: I brought the #b#t4031088#s#k back to #b#p304##k. By using them as a tracking focus, she traced the magical disturbance to somewhere deep in the woods. She wants to tell me where.

0.0: Hmm... that magic feels... familiar.\nI've noticed #r#o37#s#k in #b#m010002081##k have been digging up items with a similar type of magic.
0.1: Hunt them down and bring me #i4031088# #b25 #t4031088#s#k. I can use those to isolate the source!

yes.0: Good. Make sure to come right back when you're done.\nTry not to trip over your own feet!\n#b#p305##k would be so upset with me if a human got hurt on my watch!

no.0: Hmph. Let me know when you're ready to continue.

1.0: You're back. Hand me the root fragments. Gently!
1.1: Ah... yes. By tuning my magic to the residual corruption in these roots, I can filter out the ambient noise in the forest. My theory was correct! Now I can safely sense the source...
1.2: ...Oh my. The resonance is pulling heavily toward an area in #b#m010002000##k...\nA physical opening must have appeared in the forest.

item.0: You didn't bring all the #b#t4031088#s#k?\nI can't trace the signal without enough of them! Hurry back to the forest!
